title: Mambattiyaan
desc: After a young man's father is murdered, he turns to a life of violence and revenge. However, his twisted sense of justice is not appreciated by the police who are determined to capture him.

title: Unakkaga Ellam Unakkaga
desc: Sakthivel, an irresponsible man, disapproves of the marriage arranged for him by his father and tries to ruin it. However, he is surprised to learn that the prospective bride is the woman he loves.

title: Nee Varuvai Ena
desc: Ganesh falls for his extremely caring and helpful new neighbour, Nandini, who lives in a house opposite to his. But, when Ganesh and his parents put forth a marriage proposal, she turns them down.

title: Sandai
desc: Thangalakshmi enlists the help of Kaththi to protect herself and her daughter. Soon, oblivious of his real identity, Thangalakshmi accepts him as her son-in-law.

title: M.Kumaran S/O Mahalakshmi
desc: Kumaran, a passionate kick-boxer, is shaken when his dying mother requests he meet his estranged father in Malaysia, forcing him to confront his past and future.

title: Nandha
desc: Struggling to get by after serving time for patricide, Nandha finds true love and a new lease on life. However, misadventures soon come knocking on his door once again.

title: Kootu Puzhukkal
desc: Surya, an unemployed man, comes across Manga, his neighbour, and falls in love with her. In order to succeed, he must prove himself worthy.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: 7G Rainbow Colony
desc: Kadhir, an unemployed young man, falls in love with Anita and persistently pursues her. However, Anita insists that they can only be together if he gets his life in order.
